## SL.con: Containers

[Official text](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#ss-con)

- [SL.con.1: Prefer using STL `array` or `vector` instead of a C array](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rsl-arrays) · ours: [core-guidelines](../core-guidelines.md)
- [SL.con.2: Prefer using STL `vector` by default unless you have a reason to use a different container](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rsl-vector) · ours: [core-guidelines](../core-guidelines.md)
- [SL.con.3: Avoid bounds errors](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rsl-bounds)
- [SL.con.4: don't use `memset` or `memcpy` for arguments that are not trivially-copyable](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rsl-copy)

## SL.str: String

[Official text](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#ss-string)

- [SL.str.1: Use `std::string` to own character sequences](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rstr-string)
- [SL.str.2: Use `std::string_view` or `gsl::span<char>` to refer to character sequences](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rstr-view) · ours: [core-guidelines](../core-guidelines.md)
- [SL.str.3: Use `zstring` or `czstring` to refer to a C-style, zero-terminated, sequence of characters](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rstr-zstring)
- [SL.str.4: Use `char*` to refer to a single character](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rstr-charp)
- [SL.str.5: Use `std::byte` to refer to byte values that do not necessarily represent characters](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rstr-byte)
- [SL.str.10: Use `std::string` when you need to perform locale-sensitive string operations](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rstr-locale)
- [SL.str.11: Use `gsl::span<char>` rather than `std::string_view` when you need to mutate a string](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rstr-span)
- [SL.str.12: Use the `s` suffix for string literals meant to be standard-library `string`s](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rstr-s)

## SL.io: Iostream

[Official text](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#ss-io)

- [SL.io.1: Use character-level input only when you have to](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rio-low)
- [SL.io.2: When reading, always consider ill-formed input](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rio-validate)
- [SL.io.3: Prefer `iostream`s for I/O](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rio-streams)
- [SL.io.10: Unless you use `printf`-family functions call `ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false)`](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rio-sync)
- [SL.io.50: Avoid `endl`](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#rio-endl) · ours: [core-guidelines](../core-guidelines.md)
